technical_analysis.issue: Xcode complained about undeclared selector for bb_trace_addPersistentStoreWithType:configuration:URL:options:error:
technical_analysis.root_cause: Using @selector(bb_trace_addPersistentStoreWithType:configuration:URL:options:error:) triggers GCC_WARN_UNDECLARED_SELECTOR warning because the selector is not visible at compile time in the same translation unit
technical_analysis.fix_applied: Changed to NSSelectorFromString(@"bb_trace_addPersistentStoreWithType:configuration:URL:options:error:") which creates the selector at runtime, avoiding the compile-time warning
technical_analysis.fix_correctness: This is the standard Objective-C pattern for avoiding undeclared selector warnings when the selector is defined in a category or will be added via method swizzling
